messages:
maya: Uploaded RC candidate: rc.3 (build 2026.03.22-rc.3) to artifacts. Requesting pin for the midnight change window 00:30-01:30 UTC.
deploy-bot: Artifact rc.3 registered. Canary policy templates available. To promote: `/promote rc.3 --window=00:30UTC --policy=canary-5-50`
joel: LGTM from staging. Ran smoke suite (smoke-rc.sh) — no failures, kv warm looks good.
sam: Any DB migrations or keystore ops in this RC?
maya: No DB schema changes. One config flag (enable_batching=true). Keystore unchanged.
rahul: Pin request noted. Who is taking sheriff for the window?
natasha: I'll sheriff the window and monitor. Abort criteria: error rate > 1.5% OR p50 latency +200ms baseline. I’ll post checks in ops channel. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Quiet window scheduled 00:30-01:30 UTC. Change doc: https://internal.redwood/dev/releases/3329998888 (edit access: eng-release leads)
joel: Small note for release notes: mention batching flag fallback behavior and perf expectation (~10-15% token throughput improvement).
maya: Added to release notes draft:
``nRelease notes - rc.3
- Opt-in batching flag: enable_batching=true (gradual rollout).
- No DB migrations.
- Observability: new trace tags for kv-cache.
```
sam: Prefer staged promo: 5% for 15m smoke, then 50% for 30m, then full. Any objections?
maya: Agree. That matches our canary policy. Will queue promotion with that timing.
rahul: Rollback playbook (short):
``n1) /promote rollback rc.previous OR `/promote rc.2 --force`
2) kubectl -n inference set image deploy/infer-server infer=image:vX.Y (ops script: rollback.sh)
3) Re-pin traffic-shim to safe-token endpoint, notify oncall, open postmortem if >15m outage
```
natasha: Copying rollback playbook into the change doc. I’ll run manual smoke checks at 00:45 and 00:55. If trend hits abort criteria, I’ll trigger rollback and ping product and infra.
oncall-night: Oncall here — I’m watching realtime dashboards, will escalate at the first sign.
deploy-bot: Promotion command queued by maya: `/promote rc.3 --window=00:30UTC --policy=canary-5-50 --pin=rc.3`
maya: Thanks — I’ll kick at T-10m and post status updates. If anyone needs pre-read: the artifacts and diffs are at https://artifacts.redwood/rc.3.diff
